predecessors.name: Bengal Sultanate
predecessors.text: Gauda and Bengal, which fell to Sher Shah in April 1538; Sher Shah already ruled Bihar ('Sultan of Bihar' 1530 - 6 April 1538)

successors.name: Mughal Empire
successors.text: Orissa as Cliopatria draws it from 1579: the coastal plain round Cuttack, Puri and Balasore

ledger.x: 1538: Sher Shah Suri takes Gauda and is crowned Sultan of Bengal and Bihar.
September 1538: Humayun seizes Gauda.
17 May 1540: Sher Shah routs Humayun at Kannauj and ends the war.
17 May 1540: Sher Shah becomes Sultan of Hindustan.
November 1540: the Punjab falls to the Afghans.
1541: the Afghans take Multan.
ledger.cp: Multan (holder not named on the page)

ledger.x: 1542: Sher Shah annexes Malwa.
Undated, placed 1544: Haibat Khan subjugates upper Sindh.
ledger.cp: Upper Sindh (rulers not named on the page)

ledger.x: 1544: Sher Shah's generals occupy Marwar.
July 1545: Maldeo retakes Marwar.
1555: Malwa slips away.
February 1555: the Mughals take Lahore and Rohtas Fort, opening the reconquest.
February 1555: Lahore and the Punjab of Pakistan pass to Humayun.
22 June 1555: Sikandar Shah Suri is beaten at Sirhind.
1555: the Mughals occupy Delhi.

June 1555: the fighting for the Punjab and Delhi ends with the battle of Sirhind (22 June) and the Mughal occupation of Delhi; Sikandar held out in the Sivalik Hills until he surrendered on 25 July 1557.
7 October 1556: Hemu, Adil Shah Suri's general, takes Delhi and Agra from the Mughals.
5 November 1556: Akbar's army wins the Second Battle of Panipat and recovers Delhi and Agra.
April 1557: the last Sur emperor is killed and the state lives on as the Afghan sultanate of Bengal.
1564: the Karrani dynasty takes Bengal.
1565: Sulaiman Khan moves the capital from Gaur to Tanda.
1568: Sulaiman Khan annexes Orissa.
ledger.cp: Orissa (holder not named on the page)

ledger.x: August 1574: Akbar's war for Bihar and Bengal opens at Patna.
August 1574: Patna and Hajipur fall to the Mughals.
25 September 1574: the capital falls.
10 July 1576: Rajmahal ends the war and Bengal passes to the Mughals. the decisive battle took place on 10 July 1576; Daud was captured and executed.
10 July 1576: the war for Bihar and Bengal ends at Rajmahal.
April 1592: Man Singh beats the Afghans of Orissa.
1593: Orissa is conquered.
1593: the war for Orissa ends in Mughal conquest.
1593: the last land of the Sur line, Orissa, passes to the Mughal Empire after Man Singh's conquest.

wars.name: Humayun's war against Sher Shah (Gauda, Chausa, Kannauj)
wars.outcome: Sur victory: Gauda fell to Sher Shah in April 1538, Humayun seized it on 8 September 1538, the Mughals were routed at Chausa (1539) and at Kannauj on 17 May 1540, and Humayun fled to Sindh.

wars.name: Sur conquest of the Punjab, Multan and Malwa
wars.outcome: Lahore taken in November 1540, Multan in 1541, Malwa annexed in 1542 with Gwalior subjugated.

wars.name: Sher Shah's Marwar campaign (Sammel)
wars.outcome: Sher Shah marched with 80,000 cavalry in early 1543; after Sammel (1544) Khawas Khan took Jodhpur and held Marwar from Ajmer to Mount Abu; Maldeo recaptured Jodhpur by July 1545 and his territories by 1546.

wars.name: Siege of Kalinjar
wars.outcome: Sher Shah besieged Kalinjar Fort in 1544 and was mortally wounded; he died there on 22 May 1545.

wars.name: Islam Shah's wars with the Niazis and Gakhars
wars.outcome: Islam Shah beat the Niazis at Ambala; Haibat Khan took refuge with the Gakhars in 1548 and 'for next two years' Islam Shah 'could not defeat Gakhars or capture Haibat Khan'; the conflict with the Gakhars lasted to the end of the dynasty.

wars.name: Battle of Sirhind and the Mughal reconquest of Hindustan
wars.outcome: Lahore and Rohtas fell to the Mughals in February 1555, Sikandar lost at Sirhind on 22 June 1555 and the Mughals occupied Delhi; Hemu retook Delhi and Agra on 7 October 1556 and lost them at Second Panipat on 5 November 1556.

wars.name: Mughal conquest of Bengal
wars.outcome: Patna and Hajipur in August 1574, Tanda on 25 September 1574, Tukaroi on 3 March 1575, Daud's submission at Cuttack on 12 April 1575 (Orissa kept), Rajmahal on 10 July 1576 and Daud's execution.

wars.name: Mughal conquest of Odisha
wars.outcome: Man Singh set out in April 1590, the Afghans broke a treaty at Puri in 1591, Man Singh won near the Subarnarekha in April 1592 and conquered Odisha the following year; Ramchandra Deva of Khurda became a Mughal vassal.

certainty.note: Sher Shah's empire and the Punjab, Malwa and Marwar frontiers are approximate; no page gives a surveyed boundary.
The sultanate of Bengal and the Afghans of Orissa have no boundary on the pages opened; the Cuttack submission of 1575 ('Treaty of Katak') cedes Bengal and Bihar by name, not by line.
